dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Ah, welcome, please take a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: I shall introduce you when the Lord returns.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't see any empty seats.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, sorry for the inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: The Lord built such a big palace yet with no place for guests to wait at the gate. I found it confusing as well.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Please wait. I will make sure to report to her about this.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Ah, so you don't know who lives here?

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: That's funny. If you don't know who owns this place, then who are you here to see?

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: I can't be of help if you don't know who you're looking for. Now, if you'll excuse my lack of decorum.
